# Simulated data
## Gamma and Log-Normal data
Obtaining the true value for optimal threshold.
```{r}
YI_logGamma <- function(mu, sigma, start = NULL, method.optim = "L-BFGS-B",
                        maxit = 200, lower = 0, upper = Inf){
  if(is.null(start)) start <- mean(mu)
  YI_logGamma_ff <- function(par, mu, sigma){
    sp <- plnorm(par, meanlog = mu[1], sdlog = sigma[1])
    se <- 1 - pgamma(par, shape = mu[2], rate = sigma[2])
    return(se + sp - 1)
  }
  YI_optim <- optim(par = start, fn = YI_logGamma_ff, mu = mu, sigma = sigma,
                    method = method.optim,
                    control = list(maxit = maxit, fnscale = -1),
                    lower = lower, upper = upper)
  return(YI_optim)
}

CtP_logGamma <- function(mu, sigma, start = NULL, method.optim = "L-BFGS-B",
                         maxit = 200, lower = 0, upper = Inf){
  if(is.null(start)) start <- mean(mu)
  CtP_logGamma_ff <- function(par, mu, sigma){
    sp <- plnorm(par, meanlog = mu[1], sdlog = sigma[1])
    se <- 1 - pgamma(par, shape = mu[2], rate = sigma[2])
    return((1 - sp)^2 + (1 - se)^2)
  }
  CtP_optim <- optim(par = start, fn = CtP_logGamma_ff, mu = mu, sigma = sigma,
                    method = method.optim,
                    control = list(maxit = maxit),
                    lower = lower, upper = upper)
  return(CtP_optim)
}

MA_logGamma <- function(mu, sigma, start = NULL, method.optim = "L-BFGS-B",
                         maxit = 200, lower = 0, upper = Inf){
  if(is.null(start)) start <- mean(mu)
  MA_logGamma_ff <- function(par, mu, sigma){
    sp <- plnorm(par, meanlog = mu[1], sdlog = sigma[1])
    se <- 1 - pgamma(par, shape = mu[2], rate = sigma[2])
    return(log(sp) + log(se))
  }
  MA_optim <- optim(par = start, fn = MA_logGamma_ff, mu = mu, sigma = sigma,
                     method = method.optim,
                     control = list(maxit = maxit, fnscale = -1),
                     lower = lower, upper = upper)
  return(MA_optim)
}
```


```{r}
mu_logG_true_2 <- c(0, 3.6)
sigma_logG_true_2 <- c(0.5, 1)
```

```{r}
tau_logG_true_2 <- YI_logGamma(mu = mu_logG_true_2,
                               sigma = sigma_logG_true_2)$par
tau_logG_true_2
```

```{r}
tau_CtP_logG_true_2 <- CtP_logGamma(mu = mu_logG_true_2,
                                    sigma = sigma_logG_true_2)$par
tau_CtP_logG_true_2
```

```{r}
tau_MA_logG_true_2 <- MA_logGamma(mu = mu_logG_true_2,
                                  sigma = sigma_logG_true_2)$par
tau_MA_logG_true_2
```

```{r}
sp_logG_true_2 <- plnorm(tau_logG_true_2, meanlog = mu_logG_true_2[1],
                         sdlog = sigma_logG_true_2[1])
se_logG_true_2 <- 1 - pgamma(tau_logG_true_2, shape = mu_logG_true_2[2],
                             rate = sigma_logG_true_2[2])
```

```{r}
sp_logG_true_2
se_logG_true_2
```

```{r}
sp_MA_logG_true_2 <- plnorm(tau_MA_logG_true_2, meanlog = mu_logG_true_2[1],
                             sdlog = sigma_logG_true_2[1])
se_MA_logG_true_2 <- 1 - pgamma(tau_MA_logG_true_2, shape = mu_logG_true_2[2],
                                rate = sigma_logG_true_2[2])
```

```{r}
sp_MA_logG_true_2
se_MA_logG_true_2
```

```{r}
n1 <- 50
n2 <- 50
```

```{r}
X1 <- rlnorm(n1, meanlog = mu_logG_true_2[1], sdlog = sigma_logG_true_2[1])
X2 <- rgamma(n2, shape = mu_logG_true_2[2], rate = sigma_logG_true_2[2])
```

To obtain the optimal threshold and plot the confidence region for optimal sensitivity and specificity, we perform the following command:

```{r}
out1 <- threshold2(x = X1, y = X2, method = "YI", kernel_type = "gauss", 
                   bwd_type = "AZZ", plot = TRUE)
```

```{r}
out2 <- threshold2(x = X1, y = X2, method = "YI", kernel_type = "gauss", 
                   bwd_type = "CV", plot = FALSE)
```

```{r}
plot(out2)
```


```{r}
out3 <- threshold2(x = X1, y = X2, method = "MA", kernel_type = "gauss",
                   bwd_type = "CV", plot = TRUE)
```

Using formula

```{r}
data_test <- data.frame(biom = c(X1, X2), diag = rep(c("1", "2"), c(n1, n2)))
```

```{r}
out4 <- threshold2(formula = biom ~ diag, data = data_test, method = "MA", 
                   kernel_type = "gauss", bwd_type = "CV", plot = TRUE)
```

```{r}
out4$ci_tau
```


The following codes are for verifying the coverage probability of EL confidence region for sensitivity and specificity at optimal threshold.
```{r}
term1 <- emplikDTA:::empi_llike_prepare(x = X1, y = X2, 
                                        tau = tau_logG_true_2, 
                                        type_F = "empi")
term2 <- emplikDTA:::empi_llike_2C(term1, spe = sp_logG_true_2,
                                   sen = se_logG_true_2)
term2 < out1$c_alp
```

Run the following chunks interactively for the 1,000-replicate coverage study.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
out_cp_1 <- sapply(1:1000, function(i, n1, n2){
  X1 <- rlnorm(n1, meanlog = mu_logG_true_2[1], sdlog = sigma_logG_true_2[1])
  X2 <- rgamma(n2, shape = mu_logG_true_2[2], rate = sigma_logG_true_2[2])
  term1 <- emplikDTA:::empi_llike_prepare(x = X1, y = X2, 
                                          tau = tau_logG_true_2, 
                                          type_F = "empi")
  term2 <- emplikDTA:::empi_llike_2C(term1, spe = sp_logG_true_2,
                                     sen = se_logG_true_2)
  out1 <- threshold2(x = X1, y = X2, method = "YI", kernel_type = "gauss", 
                     bwd_type = "AZZ", plot = FALSE, seed = i)
  return(c(term2, out1$c_alp, term2 < out1$c_alp))
}, n1 = 50, n2 = 50)
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
mean(out_cp_1[3,])
```
